The petitioner is the accused in CC No.468/2023 on the files of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Thiruvananthapuram, a case relating to the commission of offence under Section 498A IPC.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Thiruvananthapuram
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In the present petition, he seeks to quash the proceedings in the said case.
2. At the request of the counsel representing both sides, the case was referred for mediation at the instance of Ernakulam Mediation Centre, functioning within the premises of this Court.
3. After successful completion of the mediation, the mediator has filed a report, along with a Memorandum of Agreement signed by the petitioner and the 2nd respondent/de facto complainant.

As per clause(E) of the Memorandum of Agreement, the 2nd respondent/de facto complainant had expressed her willingness to quash the proceedings against the petitioner in CC No.468/2023 on the files of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Thiruvananthapuram.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Thiruvananthapuram
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The 2nd respondent has also sworn an affidavit affirming that the issues with the petitioner have been amicably settled, and that she has no subsisting grievance against him.

In view of the above settlement of the issues between the parties, there is absolutely no need to continue the prosecution proceedings 2025:KER:59713       against the accused in CC No.468/2023.
4.
The dispute involved in the said case is purely private in nature.

Since the matter has been amicably settled between the parties, the termination of prosecution proceedings against the petitioner in the said case is highly necessary to maintain the harmonious relationship between the parties, and to honour the sanctity of the mediation agreement.
